ashby:tekion:5dabd72e-93c7-441f-959e-058.text:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.


JOB INTRODUCTION:

The Database Engineer II plays a key role in supporting and optimizing Tekion’s database environments. This role develops, maintains, and scales database solutions that ensure performance, availability, and security. It involves cross-functional collaboration, hands-on development, and growing ownership of key database operations.

 


KEY ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Designs and implements database solutions, including schema changes, stored procedures, and indexing strategies.

 - Performs performance tuning, query optimization, and diagnostics to resolve system bottlenecks.

 - Monitors and manages database health, backups, and failover procedures across environments.

 - Automates recurring maintenance and data processing tasks using SQL and scripting tools.

 - Collaborates with development, DevOps, and product teams to align database design with application needs.

 - Participates in code reviews, documentation, and the enforcement of best practices.

 - Supports incident response and root cause analysis for database-related issues.



BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 4–6 years of experience in database engineering or administration

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

 - Proficiency in SQL, scripting (e.g., Python, Bash), and data management tools

 - Experience with database performance tuning, monitoring, and recovery strategies

 - Familiarity with relational and NoSQL platforms (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB)

 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work across engineering and infrastructure teams

 


PERKS & BENEFITS 

 - Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale. 

 - Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud-native & AI driven platform. 

 - Innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. 

Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby

Note: Tekion recently transitioned to a new recruiting tool and we appreciate your patience and feedback as we adjust to our new system!



Tekion is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, victim of violence or having a family member who is a victim of violence, the intersectionality of two or more protected categories, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

recruitee:tether:2784242.title: Automation QA Engineer (QVAC) (100% remote)
recruitee:tether:2784242.text:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job
We’re looking for an  Automation QA Engineer with strong automation skills who also takes ownership of manual testing for our desktop and mobile applications.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain desktop and mobile test automation for critical user flows.

Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast and reliable.

Investigate failures, fix flaky tests, and manage test data and environments

Report clear, reproducible bugs and verify fixes

Work with developers and product on testability and acceptance criteria

Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, and regression testing of new features

 Choose manual or automated coverage based on risk; maintain regression suites.

Mandatory:

4+ years in QA automation, plus hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience.

Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript.

Experience running tests in CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions).

Hands-on experience with Playwright for desktop or web, and WebdriverIO + Appium for mobile.

Experience testing Electron and/or React Native apps, including on real iOS and Android devices.

Experience using AI tools in QA and critically reviewing their output. Testing AI-powered applications is a plus.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.
When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly. 

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

 You will:
 - Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
 - Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
 - Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
 - Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
 - Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

Experience working with a remote team

Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

greenhouse:toast:8261282.title: GTM Engineer, Web
greenhouse:toast:8261282.text:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.

Toast’s Marketing Operations AI team is the central team responsible for improving marketing performance, quality and efficiency with AI. As the team’s AI Solutions Specialist for Web, you’ll build the AI workflows and experiences that speed up web production and increase website conversion. You’ll also help drive AI adoption and fluency across the broader marketing org. You’ll be a part of the Marketing Operations AI Team, with a dotted line to Web & eCommerce, and work with Web Platform, CRO, PMM, SEO, Legal and Brand.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

In your first 6 months: you’ll measurably cut web production cycle time and lift visit-to-opportunity conversion through AI-powered site experiences.

 Web production responsibilities 

Map the page and copy the production process, including the SEO, PMM, Legal and Brand checkpoints, and build AI workflows that cut cycle time and rework.

Standardize requirements intake with templates, intake agents and automated briefs.

Build efficiencies in Contentful, its plug-ins and connected tools with Web Platform engineering.

Find and fix bottlenecks in the web scrum process, from prioritization through deployment.

Website experience responsibilities

Assist in building AI-powered experiences that improve visit-to-opportunity conversion.

Build first-party AI tools for use on the Web, including prompts and evals.

Configure and improve third-party tools: on-site chat, data enrichment, voice AI and personalization.

Set guardrails for AI on the public website with Legal, Brand and Privacy.

Define success metrics, run experiments to prove impact, and monitor live tools.

Scale responsibilities

Build reusable systems, and document playbooks so teams can run tools on their own.

Share what works beyond the Web through demos, training and office hours, and help shape marketing’s AI standards and tools.

Advise on build vs. buy decisions.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

5+ years in web operations, web production, CRO/growth, marketing technology or solutions engineering, with recent hands-on AI building.

Shipped AI agents or automated workflows that teams use every day.

Experience running or redesigning a website production process (CMS, intake, review, release). Contentful preferred.

Experience designing experiments and tying website changes to pipeline.

Experience with evals, monitoring and guardrails for customer-facing AI.

Clear communicator with technical and non-technical teams, with experience training others on new tools. Works independently end to end.

Special Sauce* (Nice to Haves)

On-site chat, chatbot, voice AI or personalization tools.

LLM APIs and agent tooling (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, MCP, RAG) and automation platforms (Zapier, Workato, n8n).

AI governance: legal review, accessibility, privacy and consent.

Web-to-CRM lead flow: forms, enrichment, routing, attribution. Clay is a plus.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.
Zone A
$124,000—$198,000 USD

Zone B
$108,000—$173,000 USD

Zone C
$97,000—$155,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!

Toast is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive hiring process. As part of this commitment, we strive to provide reasonable accommodations for persons with disabilities to enable them to access the hiring process. If you need an accommodation to access the job application or interview process, please contact candidateaccommodations@toasttab.com.
